page.overview:
Who is Dockson?

Dockson is a member of Kelsier's crew on Scadrial. Hethumb performs as Kelsier's right-hand man and the two have been friends for a long time, working together to topple The Lord Ruler. Dockson is the only non-Allomancer amongst the crew.
